summary.en: Loose motions since yesterday, eight to ten times, with cramps and no vomiting or fever. Electral a glass after each loose motion and Metrogyl 400 three times a day after food for five days. Light diet, come at once if blood in stool or dizziness.

medications.name: Electral
medications.dose: 1 glass (1 sachet in 1 litre of water)

instructions.text: Eat khichdi, curd and banana, avoid fried and outside food
Come immediately if there is blood in the stool or dizziness
